description: Defines a custom annotation HonoTimestamp for serializing and deserializing Instant fields in ISO-8601 offset date-time format, including internal serializer and deserializer classes.

classes.name: Deserializer
classes.description: Jackson deserializer for ISO 8601 offset date-time strings converting them to Instant objects.

classes.name: Serializer
classes.description: Jackson serializer for Instant objects converting them to ISO 8601 string format.

methods.name: _deserialize
methods.description: Converts ISO-8601 offset date-time string to Instant, normalizing to UTC.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Serializes Instant to ISO-8601 string in UTC.
